title: Add SBOM pointer + sha256 to offline bundle manifest and verify offline
author: Jordan Lee
release_notes: - Offline bundle manifest can now include SBOM metadata (path/URI + sha256). - Installer preflight verifies SBOM hash offline when present; fails closed on mismatch/missing file in offline mode.
description: Context: Air-gapped customers are asking for a verifiable SBOM as part of the offline bundle so they can do internal intake (security scanning / procurement) without relying on external links. We already sign the manifest and verify artifact hashes; this PR extends the manifest to reference the SBOM artifact(s) and verifies the SBOM file hash offline during preflight. Summary of changes: (1) Manifest schema: adds an optional `sbom` entry with fields for `uri` (relative path in bundle or file:// URI), `sha256` (hex), and `format` (e.g., spdx-json, cyclonedx-json). The SBOM entry is included in the signed manifest payload, so tampering is detected via signature verification and also via explicit hash verification. (2) Bundle layout convention: recommends placing SBOMs under `sbom/` in the bundle root (e.g., `sbom/redwood-private-<version>.spdx.json`). The manifest stores the relative path (preferred) or file:// URI for non-standard layouts. We explicitly do NOT support fetching SBOMs over the network during install; if the manifest uses http(s) and `--air-gapped` is enabled, preflight fails with an actionable error. (3) Installer preflight: adds a verification step `verifySbom()` executed after manifest signature verification and before chart/image checks. Behavior: if `sbom` is present, the installer resolves the SBOM file path, computes sha256, compares to manifest, and fails closed on mismatch; if the SBOM file is missing, it fails in air-gapped mode and warns (non-fatal) in connected mode (to preserve forward-compat while we migrate internal bundle builders). If `sbom` is not present, preflight proceeds with a single warning line noting SBOM verification was skipped. (4) Tests: adds unit tests for schema parse + canonicalization (sbom fields included), and preflight verification tests covering: missing sbom file, mismatched hash, and a valid SBOM hash. Adds a regression test to ensure we never attempt network access in air-gapped mode even if a URI is mistakenly set to https://. (5) UX: introduces specific error codes/messages used by Support: `BUNDLE_SBOM_NOT_FOUND`, `BUNDLE_SBOM_HASH_MISMATCH`, `BUNDLE_SBOM_URI_UNSUPPORTED_OFFLINE`. Includes remediation tips (verify transfer integrity, re-extract bundle, confirm you have the correct SBOM file that matches the bundle build id). Implementation notes: The manifest remains canonicalized via our existing stable JSON encoder; the new `sbom` fields are treated as normal keys and appear deterministically. We intentionally kept this additive (no schema version bump) to avoid bricking older bundles; older installer versions will ignore the new fields, but this installer will verify them when present. Follow-ups (out of scope here): (a) make SBOM presence required for GA bundles (gated in release tooling), (b) allow multiple SBOMs (per-component) if compliance asks; current schema supports a single top-level SBOM pointer which is sufficient for pilot customers. Security considerations: This reduces supply-chain risk for offline deployments by ensuring the SBOM itself is integrity-protected and tied to the exact bundle contents. It also prevents a class of “swap SBOM during transfer” issues that came up during customer security reviews. Related: ENG-4821 (manifest schema/canonicalization), ENG-4823 (installer verification), ENG-4829 (audit events for verification outcomes; this PR does not add new audit events beyond existing preflight result logging).

review_conversation: Marcus Lin (Security) requested we fail closed on SBOM hash mismatch and ensure no network fetch occurs in air-gapped mode, even if a URI is provided. Author updated the resolver to reject http(s) URIs when `--air-gapped` is true and added a regression test that asserts no outbound attempts. Kevin Osei asked whether the SBOM hash verification result would be visible in support bundles/audit logs; Jordan noted this PR only adds preflight errors and warnings and referenced ENG-4829/PR-25011 for wiring bundle metadata into support bundles. Ethan Park requested clearer messaging for the “SBOM missing in connected mode” case to avoid confusing customers; author adjusted the warning to include next steps (rebuild bundle / contact support) and added the exact path that was attempted. Connor O'Brien asked about schema compatibility with older installers and release tooling; author confirmed the field is optional and that release tooling can start populating it immediately without needing a manifest version bump, and added a small note to docs/offline-bundles.md.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main after approvals (Marcus Lin, Ethan Park) and CI green. Squash commit message: "Add SBOM pointer + sha256 to offline bundle manifest"
